extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of philosophy (Schopenhauer/Kant/Plato)
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from Schopenhauer's metaphysical exposition distinguishing the world as will (thing-in-itself) and as idea (objectified will/Platonic Ideas), comparing Kant and Plato and discussing teleology, organism, and purpose in nature. Intended to explain metaphysical concepts rather than provide prescriptive evaluation criteria.
